messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated error rate and tail latency on multiple routes. Significant impact observed on embeddings and rerank routes across primary regions. Threshold breached: errors > 7% for 3m.
alex (oncall): I'm digging in. Noticed large token-heavy payloads and a spike in multi-request clients making parallel embed requests. Chat route is ok but risk of collateral impact.
carmen (support): Multiple customers reporting timeouts; top two are lumo-ai and retailx. They've provided request ids.
alex (oncall): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply route-specific token-per-minute soft quotas (token-based throttles) for embeddings and rerank 2) apply temporary preferential routing to protect chat 3) enable traffic-shaper to cap batch_size per request and lower max parallelism 4) Postmortem & client outreach.
alex (oncall): Implementing token-based quota: use quota-manager to set tokens/min to enforce per-endpoint behavior. Command:```bash
quota-manager set --route /v1/embeddings --limit 150000 --unit tokens_per_min --scope global --reason "emergency token throttle to stabilize embeddings pool"
quota-manager set --route /v1/rerank --limit 30000 --unit tokens_per_min --scope global --reason "emergency rerank throttle"
```
devops-bot: quota-manager changes accepted and applied to active policy set 'incident-3200001111'.
ops: Observed immediate drop in sustained GPU memory pressure after token throttle. However one client still makes huge parallel requests.
alex (oncall): Carve out per-customer emergency throttle for lumo-ai to prevent them from using >20% of embeddings tokens:```bash
quota-manager set --customer lumo-ai --route /v1/embeddings --limit 30000 --unit tokens_per_min --duration 45m --reason "noisy client mitigation"
```
alex (oncall): Next: prefer chat traffic. We'll use route-weighting to divert spare capacity from embeddings to chat by adjusting routing weights. This is a soft shift so chat flows stay within SLOs. Command:```bash
traffic-shaper weight --from /v1/embeddings --to /v1/chat --percent 25 --regions all --reason "protect chat UX"
```
devops-bot: routing weights updated; preview shows embeddings throughput capacity -25% and chat +25% in weight model.
ml-ops: Suggest we also cap incoming batch_size server-side to limit per-request resource usage. I'll push an enforcement rule to nginx-ingress.
alex (oncall): Applying batch cap rule: max tokens per request 512 for embeddings and 128 for rerank for non-enterprise tiers. Rule:```yaml
- route: /v1/embeddings
  max_tokens_per_request: 512
  tiers: free,starter
- route: /v1/rerank
  max_tokens_per_request: 128
  tiers: free,starter
```
devops-bot: ingress rule deployed to canary nodes.
ops: After token quotas + batch caps, 5xx decreased from 9.4% to 2.1% over 10m, tail p99 latency for embeddings reduced by ~1.2s.
carmen (support): Notified retailx and lumo-ai about temporary throttles and suggested they implement exponential backoff and reduce batch sizes. Asking for SDK versions.
ravi (oncall-next): Taking handoff in 10. Anything else I should be ready to do?
alex (oncall): If errors climb again: 1) flip rerank to disabled for free and trial tiers (feature-flag toggle) 2) move a small percentage of non-critical embeddings traffic to a CPU fallback model via routing policy 3) escalate to eng-runtime if kernel OOMs or mem spikes reappear. Commands:```bash
feature-flag set rerank false --scope tiers=free,trial --reason "emergency disable to reclaim tokens"
routing-policy add --route /v1/embeddings --fallback-model cpu-fallback --percent 10 --duration 60m --reason "protect GPU pool"
```
alex (oncall): I'm also enabling a short-lived automatic soft-throttle policy that will detect batch_size>1024 and apply a short 30s penalty window per client fingerprint. This will avoid manual per-customer patches for clear misbehaving clients.
devops-bot: auto-throttle rule created: detect=batch_size>1024 action=penalize(duration=30s) scope=client_fingerprint.
ops: System telemetry shows rapidly reduced parallel allocations; free GPU slots recovered. Current metrics: embeddings errors 2.1%, rerank errors 1.8%, chat errors 0.9%. Token consumption rate down 42%.
alcarmen (support): typo check failed
carmen (support): ignore previous. continuing.
alex (oncall): Logging and evidence: save sample request payloads, write manifests to s3://incidents/3200001111/artifacts and tag changes with INC-3200001111. Create a post-incident doc in incidents tracker and schedule 1hr follow-up with eng-ml and infra.
ravi (oncall-next): I've taken over monitoring. Leaving these follow-ups: - add route-specific default token quotas in Console UI - add an automated alert for token-imbalance across routes - add a heuristics detector for sudden spike in client parallelism.
carmen (support): I'll follow up with the customers after 30m with status and include suggested client-side mitigations + the incident id.
alex (oncall): Good work. Marking incident as mitigated for now. Will keep it open for postmortem actions. :white_check_mark:
